case.goal: Unpaired 2D domain translation and mode-level bijection (G_xy, G_yx, D_y, D_x) between an 8-mode ring (R=2.5, sigma=0.08) and an 8-mode square-perimeter constellation ({-2, 0, +2}^2 \ {(0, 0)}, sigma=0.08) with cycle-consistency regularization (Zhu et al. ICCV 2017; Kim et al. ICML 2017).
case.sampling: Unpaired draws x ~ P_X (8-mode ring, R=2.5, sigma=0.08) and y ~ P_Y (8-mode square perimeter {-2, 0, +2}^2 \ {(0,0)}, sigma=0.08); evaluated on N=4096 held-out unpaired samples without output noise.
case.scope: Unpaired 2D cross-domain translation (G_xy, G_yx, D_y, D_x) with cycle-consistency regularization and recipe-owned particle prior coupling.
case.title: Unpaired 2D domain translation & bijection (CycleGAN / DiscoGAN)
